note:
Level 1, both label levels read (.sav copied from the wallace_2026_mcm_culture cache; sha256 matches all 13 cached copies; the S2c .sps (sha256 95cbbb05...2ea4e1262) computes IQT1/certain/MCMcheck/interRC only and contains no COVIDcert text). CODE DERIVATION: SINGLE spec s2c_covidcert.csv = (s2c, COVIDcert{i} -> covidcert{i}, rev 0) for i = 1..6: a number-preserving lowercase rename, no '-' flip prefix, so resp is the deposited value and the live table has no itemcov_recoded column. NO RECODE APPLIES: the docstring's 8 - resp rewrite is for pooled tables (certain, belong, concern, learn, apply, rec) only; this single-study table is left as deposited. Exempt from Step 5b (number-preserving rename), no verification files. Variable labels are .sav columns 88-93 (0-based 87-92), between intoluncert5 and wino1. Shipped verbatim except two deliberate artifact repairs: embedded line breaks (Qualtrics export artifacts: 'The
COVID-19', 'look
like', 'It
is', 'My
future') replaced by single spaces, and COVIDcert2's 'Becauseof' split to 'Because of' (a lost space at the same kind of break; not what respondents read). No lead-in/instructions text in the .sav or .sps, so instructions left blank. OPTIONS: unlike the Study 2 siblings, all seven points are value-labelled for every item: 1 Strongly agree, 2 Agree, 3 Somewhat agree, 4 Neither agree nor disagree, 5 Somewhat disagree, 6 Disagree, 7 Strongly disagree; shipped verbatim for all 7 points (no number prefixes present). COVIDcert5's label 5 reads 'Somewhat Disagree' (capital D) and is kept as deposited. DIRECTION: 1 = Strongly agree, so high resp = less agreement = less perceived COVID uncertainty. Labels corroborated by the distributions: item means 2.08-2.59 on items 1-5 and 3.60 on item 6 (personal future), i.e. most respondents on the agree side of 'the pandemic has created a lot of uncertainty', which is the only plausible reading; the flipped reading would have 72% disagreeing that there is a lot of uncertainty in the world. Inter-item r 0.47-0.78, all positive (no reverse-worded item). Script docstring lists _s2c_covidcert among the 1 = Strongly agree tables. Sanity counts (not required for the exemption): source 793 rows, 793 non-missing per item; live 4758 rows = 793 ids x 6; per-item resp-count vectors (1..7) source = live exactly: covidcert1 243/271/189/32/22/24/12, covidcert2 292/283/148/33/17/12/8, covidcert3 229/254/178/63/32/23/14, covidcert4 185/252/201/66/48/29/12, covidcert5 202/236/193/68/53/30/11, covidcert6 108/122/188/128/101/100/46. Dictionary Description: Certainty about COVID-19 beliefs (the items themselves are statements of COVID-related uncertainty). Rights: items carry no source-instrument attribution in the deposit and appear study-authored; no fee, permission, NC or redistribution clause located (silence = permission). Not in instrument_rights_register.csv (the IUS row governs intoluncert, not this table); no register row written.
public_note: Responses run 1 = Strongly agree to 7 = Strongly disagree, so a higher value means less agreement that COVID-19 has created uncertainty.
